title: Midnight Sunwatch
text:
🌙 Midnight Sunwatch — November 18, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Moderate (C1.4)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C2.0 (Peaked November 18, 2026 at 03:55 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: M1.7 (Peaked November 17, 2026 at 21:39 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 393 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.33)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

Things are flickering on the Sun. 🔥🌞

Several bright active regions and sunspot groups are visible across the solar disk today; the coronagraph view looks routine.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
